channel.title: Penta AI Guides
channel.description: Practical guides to website fonts, colors, CSS and design systems.

item.title: How to Extract a Design System from an Existing Website
item.description: Audit colors, typography, spacing, and component states on a live website. Build a useful token inventory while separating observations from assumptions.

item.title: How to Find the Font on a Website in Chrome
item.description: Identify a website’s real rendered font, size, weight, and line height in Chrome. Learn why font stacks and screenshot guesses can mislead you.

item.title: How to Extract a Website Color Palette That You Can Use
item.description: Find a website’s colors in Chrome, separate CSS values from screenshot samples, and turn the result into a named palette with contrast checks.

item.title: How to Inspect CSS on a Website with Chrome DevTools
item.description: Find the CSS behind any page element, understand computed styles, and check layouts, hover states, and responsive behavior in Chrome DevTools.

item.title: Turn Website Design Tokens into a Tailwind CSS v4 Theme
item.description: Map inspected colors and radii into semantic CSS variables and a Tailwind v4 theme, with an original example and component validation checklist.

item.title: DESIGN.md: A Practical Design Brief for AI Coding
item.description: Use this DESIGN.md template to give an AI coding assistant clear design tokens, layout rules, component states, evidence, and review criteria.

item.title: Web Font Not Loading? A Chrome Debugging Checklist
item.description: Find why a web font falls back in Chrome. Check font requests, CSS paths, family names, weights and missing characters with a repeatable debugging workflow.

item.title: How to Check Website Color Contrast, State by State
item.description: Audit text, buttons and focus indicators against their real backgrounds. Learn contrast thresholds, inspect transparent colors and record actionable fixes.

item.title: Why Your CSS Is Not Applying: Debug the Cascade
item.description: Find why a CSS declaration loses without adding random important flags. Trace selector matches, cascade layers, specificity, inheritance and source order.

item.title: CSS Grid vs Flexbox: Choose by the Layout You Need
item.description: Choose Grid or Flexbox using card alignment, wrapping and content behavior. Compare practical layouts, nested patterns and common sizing problems.

item.title: How to Find and Fix Horizontal Overflow on Mobile
item.description: Track down the element making a page wider than its viewport. Fix grid minimums, long content, media and fixed widths without hiding useful content.

item.title: How to Build a CSS Spacing Scale from Real Components
item.description: Turn inconsistent margins, padding and gaps into a small CSS spacing scale. Audit component roles, handle exceptions and validate narrow layouts.

item.title: Fluid Typography with CSS clamp(): A Worked Example
item.description: Create headings that scale between readable limits with CSS clamp. Calculate a fluid range, combine rem and viewport units, and test zoom behavior.

item.title: How to Inspect and Rebuild a CSS Box Shadow
item.description: Read CSS shadow layers, offsets, blur and spread. Rebuild subtle card elevation, identify clipping, and test the result on the intended background.

item.title: Build a Consistent Border Radius System in CSS
item.description: Choose useful radius tokens for buttons, cards and nested surfaces. Inspect real corners, avoid clipping focus rings, and document intentional exceptions.

item.title: CSS Variable Fallbacks: Missing Values vs Invalid Values
item.description: Debug CSS custom properties by tracing scope, inheritance and var fallbacks. Learn why an existing value of the wrong type can still break a declaration.

item.title: Build Dark Mode with Semantic CSS Color Tokens
item.description: Create light and dark themes with semantic CSS variables. Respect system preferences, distinguish color-scheme, and test surfaces, controls and contrast.

item.title: SVG vs PNG for Website Icons: A Practical Choice
item.description: Choose an icon format based on scaling, detail, styling and delivery. Compare SVG and PNG, set dimensions, and check sharpness at actual display sizes.

item.title: Accessible Button States: Default, Focus and Disabled
item.description: Specify buttons beyond the default screenshot. Cover keyboard focus, hover, pressed and disabled behavior with native HTML and a practical review matrix.

item.title: A Design Handoff Checklist Developers Can Verify
item.description: Hand off a website with clear tokens, assets, responsive rules and interaction states. Use acceptance criteria that can be checked in the running interface.
